successors.name: Italian Africa
successors.text: Majeerteenia, 'eventually integrated into the colony of Italian Somaliland'

rulers.name: Cismaan Suldaan Maxamuud (Boqor Osman Mahamuud, Osman II)
rulers.title: Boqor

ledger.x: 1856: the Majeerteen Sultanate of Alula and the Somali coast of Cape Guardafui, under Sultan Mahmud.
1878: Kenadid helps found the separate Sultanate of Hobyo to the south.
7 April 1889: the sultanate becomes an Italian protectorate.
October 1925: the Italians land and fight at Alula and Hafun.
Late 1927: after the fighting at Iskushuban the Majeerteen leaders retreat.
Late 1927: Majeerteenia is annexed to the Italian colony.

wars.name: Campaign of the Sultanates
wars.outcome: Italian victory: the Majeerteen Sultanate is occupied and disintegrates, 'directly annexed to the Italian colony of Somalia'; Hersi Boqor retreats to the Ogaden in late 1927.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey line: the 1889 treaty with Italy fixes no frontier on the page, and the southern boundary with Hobyo is a Cliopatria edge.
